all_four_metrics: Selection uses co-bps only. Later paired evaluation must report co-bps, fp-bps, PSTH R2 and velocity R2 using the unchanged evaluator; original TRAIN decoder fit remains, on the declared consistently scaled rates. No assumed invariance of other metrics.
candidate_family: One global positive rate multiplier; no neural dynamics, latent inference or checkpoint change.
claims: Same-VALID selection is development evidence, not held-out improvement.
Unknown checkpoint fit cohort and Table2/DANDI mapping remain unresolved.
Future TEST requires matching checkpoint lineage and candidate-aware original-task grading; do not relabel as historical author artifact.
No original-data selection, calibration, inference, grading, AI improvement, novelty or SOTA result in this source phase.
freeze_boundary: Method/grid/source and reference prediction identity before selection targets. Selection result binds gain, VALID panel/checkpoint/order lineage and evidence. Submission transform takes frozen selection and prediction only, never targets.
gain_execution: Convert the selected exact numerator/denominator to the declared numerical dtype using the source implementation; record that executed value and method/source identity.
grid_scientific_basis: A modest multiplicative mean-rate calibration baseline spanning half to twice the reference scale, with denser reciprocal pairs near identity. Range and density are predeclared design choices, not tuned to observed TEST scores or claimed optimal.
identity_requirement: Gain1 must preserve prediction bytes exactly through target-free copy/reuse; no numerical reserialization for the identity branch.
selection_metric: Original canonical co-bps semantics, authenticated evaluator; reject nonfinite scores or invalid inputs rather than invent a fallback metric.
selection_phase: VALID only; original phase, trial/neuron order and20ms binning preserved.
status: Declared before any new original prediction or target access; none authorized in this phase.
tie_rule: Maximize canonical score; exact equal maxima choose earliest entry in this fixed order. Identity is first. No post-hoc tolerance or additional gain search.
transform_contract: Apply the one gain consistently to the explicitly declared canonical prediction-rate fields, including original TRAIN decoder rates; preserve shape/order/dtype/units and all non-rate metadata. Exact field allowlist is source-bound before campaign.
